english_retrieval.snippet: # Karnataka Floor Test: CM Kumaraswamy sails through as BJP walks out. A 'confident' Karnatka Chief Minister HD Kumaraswamy will today attempt to prove that he enjoys majority support in the state assembly. The crucial floor test comes around five days after the BJP's attempt to form a government in the southern state failed because of insufficient numbers in the assembly. The Congress-JDS combine that has now formed the government is confident of winning today's floor test. Karnataka CM HD Kumaraswamy has won the floor test after 117 MLAs voted in his favour. Before walking out of the assembly, leader of opposition Yeddyurappa 'warned' the Kumaraswamy government that there will be a "state-wide protest" on Monday in Karnataka if "farm loan wavier isn't done" soon. Bharatiya Janata Party MLAs have walked out of the Karnataka assembly ahead of the floor taste that chief minister Kumaraswamy must face.
